classical_conjecture.statement: For every smooth projective complex variety X and every p, cl:CH^p(X) tensor Q -> H^{2p}(X,Q) intersect H^{p,p}(X) is surjective.
classical_conjecture.acceptance: A proof of rational cycle-class surjectivity for all such X,p.
classical_conjecture.refutation: One explicit smooth projective complex X and rational (p,p) class alpha outside the rational span of ALL codimension-p algebraic cycle classes.

objective.meaning: Test the proposed coherence-obstruction route; neither the operator's intuition nor passing net validation resolves the classical conjecture.

research_hypothesis.statement: For an explicitly selected X,p, a class-level rational obstruction derived from retained coherence may annihilate every algebraic cycle class while detecting a rational Hodge class.

scope.initial_search: Complex dimension d>=4 and 2<=p<=d-2; p=2,d=4 is the first intended search window, not a restriction of the classical conjecture.
scope.cycle_map: cl:CH^p(X)_Q -> Hdg^p(X,Q); formal rational combinations may have negative coefficients.
scope.kernel_policy: Homologically trivial cycles need not vanish in CH. Hodge asks surjectivity, not recovery of the entire cycle group or of an arbitrarily chosen witness.

obstruction_contract.noncircularity: Define and evaluate the obstruction independently of naming the desired unknown quotient Hdg/image(cl). A renamed nonalgebraic-class quotient is not a computed detector.
obstruction_contract.candidate_map: O=P((2+i)*) on Hdg^3(X,Q), with rational Weil determinant target W

semantics.depends_on: Research prerequisites, not logical implications. required_verdicts demand constructed witnesses, never merely a resolved rejected candidate.
semantics.outcome: All four-valued proof-attempt outcomes remain null; finite control constructions are not Hodge outcomes.
semantics.parent_links: References and candidate review ports only. No proof import, automatic parent discharge, source identity or physical premise.
semantics.candidate_failure: A failed obstruction, packet comparison or cycle search rejects only that candidate. Failure to construct a witness is not nonexistence.
semantics.controls: Finite positive/negative controls are necessary diagnostics, not the theorem of annihilation on all algebraic cycles.
semantics.revision: A changed X, alpha, coefficient field, obstruction or comparison map requires an explicit successor and retained rejection history.
